validated_results.title: Index-Based Dietary Patterns and the Risk of Prostate Cancer.
validated_results.reason: This is a review of published studies on a priori dietary indices and prostate cancer risk ("The purpose of this study was to review the association of prostate cancer with a priori dietary indices"), not an original human study.

validated_results.title: Index-Based Dietary Patterns and the Risk of Prostate Cancer.
validated_results.reason: The article reviews seventeen previously published studies of dietary indices including the Mediterranean Diet Score rather than reporting original primary data.

validated_results.title: Cancer, sunlight and vitamin D.
validated_results.reason: The abstract is a narrative review summarizing epidemiologic, ecological, and randomized evidence on sunlight, vitamin D, and cancer without original study data.

validated_results.title: Organoids model distinct Vitamin E effects at different stages of prostate cancer evolution.
validated_results.reason: The study tests selenium effects exclusively in prostate epithelial organoid and cell-line models ("benign (primary), premalignant ( RWPE-1) and malignant (LNCaP) prostate epithelial organoids"), a preclinical design.

validated_results.title: Organoids model distinct Vitamin E effects at different stages of prostate cancer evolution.
validated_results.reason: Vitamin E effects are examined only in organoid/cell-line experiments rather than in a human population with incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Consumption of caffeinated beverages and serum concentrations of sex steroid hormones in US men.
validated_results.reason: The outcomes are serum sex steroid hormone and SHBG concentrations ("evaluate if caffeine consumption is associated with concentrations of sex steroid hormones and SHBG"), with no prostate cancer incidence results.

validated_results.title: Consumption of caffeinated beverages and serum concentrations of sex steroid hormones in US men.
validated_results.reason: Soft drink consumption is related only to hormone and SHBG levels, and no prostate cancer incidence outcome is reported.

validated_results.title: Consumption of caffeinated beverages and serum concentrations of sex steroid hormones in US men.
validated_results.reason: Tea appears only within caffeine intake estimation and the study reports hormone concentrations rather than incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Updated analysis of vitamin D receptor gene FokI polymorphism and prostate cancer susceptibility.
validated_results.reason: This is a meta-analysis of case-control studies of the VDR FokI polymorphism ("we performed a meta-analysis of eligible studies") rather than an original nutritional exposure study.

validated_results.title: Comprehensive evaluation of the role of soy and isoflavone supplementation in humans and animals over the past two decades.
validated_results.reason: The article is a comprehensive narrative review of soy and isoflavone supplementation literature in humans and animals, not primary research.

validated_results.title: Mediating effects of cancer risk factors on the association between race and cancer incidence: analysis of the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study.
validated_results.reason: The exposure of interest is race, with alcohol consumption only an incidental component of the covariate adherence score ("adherence to guidelines on cancer-related risk factors ... and alcohol consumption"), and no alcohol-specific prostate cancer estimate is given.

validated_results.title: Diet and Other Lifestyle Factors Associated with Prostate Cancer Differ Between the German and Italian Region of Switzerland.
validated_results.journal: International journal for vitamin and nutrition research. Internationale Zeitschrift fur Vitamin- und Ernahrungsforschung. Journal international de vitaminologie et de nutrition
validated_results.reason: The outcomes are regional differences in lifestyle behaviours ("associations between the German and Italian region of Switzerland and each single lifestyle factor"), with no prostate cancer incidence estimate for alcohol.
